speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms. To determine the cause, have you noticed any specific patterns, such as blisters or redness, and have you experienced similar symptoms on other parts of your body or hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Lichenoides et Varioliformis Acuminata (PLVA) or Secondary Syphilis presenting with palmar paresthesia.
